after: Ordinary Edit/Write calls resolve `files.write.workspace` through the same policy and accounting path as shell actions. A manual class waits on a recorded decision; every authorized execution, including supervised and autonomous executions, records `execution.started` before proceeding, with a matching outcome when the harness reports a verified result. A human-open gate window follows §5.2 instead: it records `gate.bypassed` and preserves human-only refusal. (Amended APRV-304.)
before: Allow is recorded only where the class is gated: a manual class waits on a decision the log records, a supervised class appends `task.registered` and proceeds, an autonomous class appends nothing.
